name: terr_find_scenery_at
notes: [flight.md 6.3] nearest destroyable scenery object around a world point: levels 1-2, 3x3 tiles, Manhattan, override table, hit record DS:BA14 (full pseudocode)

name: terr_set_scenery_state
notes: [flight.md 6.4] store a new id for the hit scenery object: override table DS:B772 (wreck ids) or tile record byte +6; sets bit 7

name: sim_input_flight
notes: [flight.md 2.1] per-frame: key read+dispatch, stick, player aircraft model (attitude/speed/alt/fuel/G/eject), history ring

name: fm_rotate_apply
notes: [flight.md 2.2] fm_mat = A x B via 2DDC; every 8th sets dirty

name: sim_key_and_signature
notes: [flight.md 3.1] cba0(key) then the radar signature [3D5C]: speed, bank, bay +24, ECM +16, MicroProse altitude term / Lockheed +20 when [9B04]==0

name: wpn_release_countermeasure
notes: [flight.md 5.5] Release flare/chaff/decoy: decrement 3636[type], fill slot R[] at 39AA, timers, message "<name> released", sound 0xF

name: wpn_cm_tick
notes: [flight.md 5.5] tick ONLY the first busy countermeasure slot (then return); decoy lamp 7

name: wpn_gun_update
notes: [flight.md 5.6] Move gun bullets (E44E, 12 B) and spawn on fire button: ammo 3650, vel from heading/pitch, sound 6

name: hud_threat_update
notes: [flight.md 3.4] Stealth bars from 3D5C, staggered site scheduler calling 516d, threat arrow 8548/863c; 3D6A--

name: det_site_radar_update
notes: [flight.md 3.3] Per-site radar scan: 5460 signal, bars, "detected" msg, level build-up, "Radar ID" msg, SAM launch into DS:3C0C slot site&7

name: det_radar_signal
notes: [flight.md 3.2] Radar formula: (maxr-D)*cell*(2*skill+factor+1)/maxr, aspect/Doppler factor, altitude cone, halved for Lockheed model; D=dist>>6

name: det_radar_warning
notes: [flight.md 3.5] [3D92]=2*[3660] warning lamp timer; snd_cmd 8 via d6bf(8,1)

name: det_alert_network
notes: [flight.md 3.5] Alert: [3D62]=[B286], last known player pos/alt/heading, raise every radar level to floor 16*(war+skill-1)

name: ai_update_units
notes: [flight.md 4.1] per-step AI of all units: modes hunt(1)/RTB+land(2)/patrol+formation(3), combat table DS:3A8C, cannon, terrain pull-up, integration, landing/roll-out, endurance, scramble, staggered 62d0 (full pseudocode)

name: ai_unit_radar
notes: [flight.md 4.4] Aircraft radar via 5460, level build-up, "Visual ID - X" msg, air-to-air missile launch "W fired by X", lock tone snd 7

name: ai_unit_takeoff
notes: [flight.md 4.5] Place unit on airbase (carrier z=0x8C), flags|=0x403, endurance, msg "<site> - <type> taking off"

name: wpn_proj_update_all
notes: [flight.md 5.3] per-step update of the 12 projectile slots (0-7 enemy, 8-11 player): seeker/decoys, steering, move, impact, proximity burst, messages

name: wpn_seeker_check
type: int(int slot,int tx,int ty,int tz,int cls)
notes: [flight.md 5.4] 22.5 deg cone / rear-aspect test of projectile vs point; sets [94F4] dist [94F6] bearing; tz unused

name: dmg_unit_kill
notes: [flight.md 6.2] marks unit u dead (flags 0x20), logs event 3/0x83, name to 9876, sound 5, mission_target_done(0) for primary air target

name: dmg_object_destroy
notes: [flight.md 6.2] destroys ground object o: flag 0x80, wreck shape, mission target k (kind 2) done, event log 1/0xC/2, sound 5

name: mission_target_done
notes: [flight.md 6.2] primary/secondary target achieved: sets 9B05 0x40/0x20 and 2E7C 1/2/3; 9876 = Primary target or Second. target; logs 0x8B/0x4B for kinds 3/4

name: dmg_player_blast
notes: [flight.md 6.1] skill+1 random bits into [3632] damage mask and [C5C8]++; lamps 10..16 refresh; [98EE]=1; sound 4; no-op in training

name: wpn_release
notes: [flight.md 5.2] fire key: checks roll/bay/altitude, takes a store from the selected bay, fills a free projectile slot 8-11 or transfers fuel; messages Bay closed etc.

name: dmg_wobj_destroyable
notes: [flight.md 6.2] 1 if the world object found in [9F10] is not yet the wreck shape (C0AC or DEA4 by class)

name: obj_find_at
notes: [flight.md 5.4] terrain object at world point -> site index (>=1) / 0 = scratch site 0 filled / -1 none (R6 name obj_find_at)

name: wpn_site_dist
notes: [flight.md 5.4] bbb4 with site record DS:B2A4+16*site (x,y), bearing wanted

name: wpn_unit_dist
notes: [flight.md 5.4] bbb4 with unit record DS:C140+36*unit (x,y), no bearing

name: obj_dist_bearing
notes: [flight.md 5.4] [94FE]=dist2d(c987), [9502]=atan2(c9d6) if flag; relative to player [C0A4],[C0B2]; returns dist

name: mat_mul
notes: [flight.md 2.2] 3x3 Q15 C=AxB; bit-exact spec: render3d.md Part 1 (E578)

name: keypad_stick_install
notes: [flight.md 2.4] NumLock off, clear state, 2CD6/2CD7=80h, save INT 9, install keypad_stick_isr

name: keypad_stick_isr
notes: [flight.md 2.4] INT 9: keypad/arrow keys -> virtual stick bytes 2CD6/2CD7 (80h centre; 5Ah tap, 7Fh double tap), drops repeated identical keys in the BIOS buffer, chains to BIOS

name: det_radar_types
notes: Radar type table 14B; flags bit0 Doppler bit1 omni; same as START 15C6

name: actype_tab
notes: aircraft type table: name[18] then 7 words (+0x12 speed ... +0x1A model +0x1C far model +0x1E kills)

name: damage_mask
notes: Bit per damaged subsystem; bit 6 decoy launcher, bit 4 bay doors

name: fuel
notes: Fuel 10000 at start; <5000 near landing base triggers speech 45

name: wstore_tab
notes: store catalogue: short name[10], long name[12], proto type @+0x16, icon @+0x18

name: wpn_table_type
notes: store table +0x16: projectile type (-1 camera, -2 fuel tank, 0 guns)

name: cm_slots
notes: countermeasure records 4 x 12 B {x, y, -, type, timer, -}: slot 0 decoy, 1..3 flare/chaff; [39B2] = decoy timer (flight.md 5.5)

name: decoy_timer
notes: timer of countermeasure record 0: != 0 = decoy alive (missiles and hunters aim at it)

name: smoke_last
notes: index of the newest smoke record (5730, 1e9e, 479c)

name: ai_manoeuvre_tbl
notes: Combat roll command table indexed [skill row][aspect octant][bearing octant]

name: wpn_tab
notes: projectile slots 12 x 28 B (0..7 enemy, 8..11 player): simflow Part 6 2.4

name: alert_timer
notes: network alert, 250*rate on alert, -1 per step; > [9F64] = fresh (first 50 s)

name: alert_blink
notes: threat ring animation counter: rate when a radar sees the player, -1 per step in 4f2a

name: scen_find_any
notes: 1 in the image: 0d08 finds objects whose 07E0 flags are 0 too; cleared by 4b57

name: key_release_latch
notes: Enter: button 1 latch read by cb72(1) in the cba0 tail (fire)

name: ai_cur_type
notes: Aircraft type of unit being processed (5730/62d0)

name: ai_engaged_now
notes: Count of fighters in mode 1 within 0x400 this pass

name: range_shift
notes: comm+32h low byte; shift in d76b range table

name: scen_state_count
notes: records in the scenery override table DS:B772

name: aircraft_flags
notes: word: 0x01 gear up, 0x02 key 9 devices, 0x04 bay open, 0x08 brakes, 0x10 ECM jammer, 0x20 IR jammer, 0x1000 training, 0x2000/0x4000 objectives (flight.md 2.4)

name: ai_engaged_prev
notes: Previous pass count; fratricide guard for SAM/AAM launches

name: site0_backup
notes: 671a saves/restores the scratch site record 0 here

name: ai_last_x
notes: Last known player X (or decoy X)

name: site_tab
notes: site records 16 B from B2A2 (+2 x here): simflow Part 5 6.2

name: ai_last_y
notes: Last known player Y (or decoy Y)

name: scen_state_tab
notes: Changed/destroyed scenery table, 5-byte records, count DS:9902

name: det_ring_scale
notes: (sig+[3D5C])*D/100, radius scale of the map ring/arc

name: alert_pulse_in
notes: set to 0xFF by 559a; latched into [C600] and cleared every 8th step by 39c4

name: air_tab
notes: unit records 36 B from C13E (+2 x here): see flight.md 1.1

name: alert_pulse
notes: 0xFF for 8 steps after an alert: 4f2a services sites more often (+2)

name: n_active_threats
notes: Active threat count from fps estimator
